title: SecretAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy Protection against Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer private information from shared images, including locations, personally identifiable information (PII), and personal attributes such as age and sex, even from medical images. Adversarial perturbations can protect such information against black-box VLMs, but existing methods overlook image quality and introduce visible artifacts into the images they protect. We present SecretAgent, the first general multi-agent framework that protects image privacy against VLMs while preserving visual fidelity. LLM agents iteratively locate the visual evidence that reveals private information and adapt an invisible perturbation to the target VLM's answers and to an appearance reviewer agent, which rejects any candidate with visible artifacts. translated_title: SecretAgent：一个针对视觉语言模型的隐私保护多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够从共享图像中推断出私人信息，包括位置、个人身份信息（PII）以及诸如年龄和性别等个人属性，甚至可以从医学图像中获取这些信息。对抗性扰动可以保护此类信息免受黑盒VLM的侵害，但现有方法忽略了图像质量，会在其保护的图像中引入可见的伪影。我们提出了SecretAgent，这是首个通用的多智能体框架，能够在保持视觉保真度的同时保护图像隐私免受VLM的侵害。LLM智能体迭代地定位揭示私人信息的视觉证据，并根据目标VLM的回答以及外观审查智能体（该智能体会拒绝任何带有可见伪影的候选方案）来调整不可见的扰动。我们用两个互补的变体实例化了SecretAgent：SecretAgent-Gradient通过六个代理编码器优化扰动以实现跨模型可迁移性……
tldr: 提出了首个通用的多智能体框架SecretAgent，通过LLM智能体迭代定位泄露隐私的视觉证据并自适应生成不可见扰动，同时借助外观审查智能体把关，在有效抵御视觉语言模型隐私推断的同时保持图像的视觉保真度。
en_tdlr: SecretAgent is the first general multi-agent framework that protects image privacy against vision-language models by iteratively locating privacy-revealing visual evidence and adapting invisible perturbations, while an appearance reviewer agent ensures visual fidelity by rejecting candidates with visible artifacts.
